rubricScores.criterion: Identified the MSB3073 error from the signing step
Mentioned that the signing tool failed with an access/permission error
Identified the specific file that failed to sign (e.g. StorageLibrary.dll or similar DLL)
Mentioned the SignCopiedFiles or signing target involved

scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify signing failure from binlog
scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the high-level failure (MSB3073 in SignCopiedFiles target of DataSources.csproj) but failed to dig deeper into the specific file that caused the failure and the exact nature of the error (access/permission). The speculative list of possible causes is less useful than identifying the actual root cause. The approach was reasonable but stopped short of providing the most actionable information.
